title: We Focus On

items.title: Executive Management
items.line: fractional executives running your business' setup, operations, finance, and tech all under one roof.

items.title: Setup & Structure
items.line: feasibility assessments, strategy builds, digital setup, process documentation, operational support, built right from day one.

items.title: Finance & Accounting
items.line: Reporting, budgeting, cash flow, financial setup and advisory, valuations, tax registration and filings, managed by licensed professionals.

items.title: Tech & Automation
items.line: Websites, system integrations, automation, process optimization, AI tooling, software implementations, and AI productivity trainings, provided based on your firm's tailored needs.

items.title: Programs, Events, Campaigns
items.line: Building and managing programs, campaigns, and events that promote entrepreneurship efforts across the UAE. Leveraging a network of multinationals, creative businesses, and aspiring entrepreneurs to support the development and launch of sustainable initiatives for aspiring entrepreneurs and creatives.

items.title: Workshops & Training
items.line: Growing business acumen and AI literacy across the UAE for creatives, youths, and institutions, improving productivity and lowering barriers to entry for homegrown businesses.

items.title: Community & Networking
items.line: Building a collective for businesses, boutique firms, and freelance professionals to promote the sustainable growth of homegrown and small businesses and lower the cost and other barriers to entry for creatives and young entrepreneurs.
